scope: Current-export native-only expressions compare EyeOpen and actual helper/face pixels to a separate direct Core renderer. Hybrid PNG reference thresholds are unchanged. Ownership adds independently isolated actual-alpha support of exactly 28 approved local glyph/helper IDs across original/current states, never difference pixels. Outside/reopening remain byte-exact with non-eye and single-pixel negative controls. This comparison does not replace strict neutral-versus-original acceptance.
